_README: Manually entered FanGraphs constants, used ONLY when the live fetch fails.
FanGraphs sits behind Cloudflare bot scoring that challenges scripted
clients (and, since 2026-08-04, GitHub's runners too), but a logged-in
browser loads the pages fine — so these get read by eye and typed here.
This file is COMMITTED on purpose: CI checks out the repo, so a gitignored
copy would never reach the pipeline.
Precedence: live fetch wins. This is only consulted when the fetch raises,
so the pipeline self-heals the moment FanGraphs lets requests through again.
guts     - https://www.fangraphs.com/tools/guts (Guts! table, current season row)
Use the 'Basic (5yr)' column, DIVIDED BY 100 (FG shows 101 -> 1.01).
All 30 teams required; a partial set is refused, because the
missing teams would silently fall back to neutral 1.0.
Update enteredAt whenever you refresh the numbers — the pipeline prints it
so a stale hand-entry is visible in the log rather than silent.
source: recovered from the 2026-08-04 13:57 pipeline run, which fetched FanGraphs successfully
